# WorldView

WorldView is an open-source dashboard for exploring global news, geospatial events, infrastructure, markets, and public safety signals.

## Links

- Production: https://osint-worldview-cyan.vercel.app
- Source: https://github.com/amanimran786/osint-worldview
- Security: https://github.com/amanimran786/osint-worldview/blob/main/SECURITY.md

Data availability and freshness depend on upstream public sources. WorldView reports unavailable data rather than presenting generated placeholders as live observations.
